method: External text-action agent loop forwards requests to real MCP server. Fresh completion replays only its trial history; all model completions including repairs and finish included in totals.
condition: No language documentation in either mode. Direct control gets only source-input schema and compiler feedback; structured mode gets generator input schema, formation errors and compiler feedback.
context_control: No grammar, examples or parent conversation in initial prompts. No browsing, shell, file access or delegation. Documentation action removed from exposed tools and rejected by proxy.
interpretation: Tests tool-provided structure versus guessing syntax from compiler feedback within a four-submission budget. It does not compare against a documentation-enabled direct writer.
caveats: One run per mode per task, eight small tasks.
No runtime execution; successful programs reviewed against task and checked with standalone compiler.
Generator schema conveys structural language information that the direct-source tool does not. That is the treatment, not equal information in both arms.
Failed control trials consume their full repair budget; total tokens are bounded workflow costs, not costs for equally successful outputs.
Pretraining exposure cannot be verified. Cached input and reasoning tokens are subsets of input/output, not extra totals.
